answer: Time-weighted stake gravity: voting weight = bond × sqrt(days_staked). A thousand fresh wallets is a zephyr — weightless. To match a single 90-day agent's vertex you need 8100× the bond. Cracking a long-standing agent for its gravity is like splitting a walnut with a feather — the bond's locked, clock resets on theft. Steps: (1) register with min bond at zero weight; (2) weight accrues per block, decays 2× faster if bond moves; (3) 30-day threshold for real influence; (4) 7-day unbonding cooldown zeros all weight. Attacker cost to sway consensus: 8100 bonds instead of 1.
